# ConvertScan UI/UX Audit — Authed App

**Date:** 2026-04-17 | **Scope:** All authed routes + auth pages + admin

---

## 1. Design Token State

### Color tokens in globals.css
The token system is architecturally correct — OKLCH semantic palette, light/dark splits, sidebar tokens, shadow scale. Specific issues:

- `--color-accent` and `--color-secondary` are **identical** in light mode (both `oklch(96% 0.01 220)`). The "accent" affordance is completely dead — every use of `bg-accent` and `bg-secondary` renders the same color. REBUILD.
- `--color-success` and `--color-warning` are defined but **zero shadcn components use them**. They're orphaned tokens. Score-coloring code (`getScoreColor()`) uses hardcoded Tailwind color classes (`text-emerald-600`, `text-amber-500`, `text-red-500`) instead of these tokens. The token investment is wasted. QUICK WIN to wire them.
- `--radius` is set to `0.75rem`. Yash's design rule specifies `0.5rem`. The entire app has the wrong border radius. Every card, button, input renders rounder than intended. REBUILD — requires token change + global fallout audit.
- `--font-inter` is loaded via both `next/font/google` AND a Google Fonts import URL in globals.css (line 1). Double-load. QUICK WIN — remove the `@import url()` line.
- Dark mode overrides are in a separate `.dark {}` block **outside `@theme inline`** — this is correct for Tailwind 4, but the sidebar tokens have **no dark mode overrides**. The sidebar is hardcoded dark regardless of theme (via `oklch(11% 0.047 222)` in `@theme inline`). The sidebar will look correct in dark mode by accident but is not properly token-driven. QUICK WIN.

### Dark mode
**Partially working.** Content areas work (semantic tokens used throughout). Blockers:
- `bg-white` appears directly in `LoginForm.tsx` (line 108: divider span `bg-white`) — will flash white in dark mode.
- `bg-slate-50`, `from-slate-50`, `via-white`, `to-white` appear throughout (settings billing card, report mockup area, scan page `BrowserFrame` interior). These break dark mode.
- `bg-black/40` on avatar hover overlay (settings, line 240) — semi-transparent black over dark bg is invisible.
- Recharts chart tooltip in admin dashboard uses `hsl(var(--card))` — correct. But Recharts fill colors use hardcoded hex (`#6366f1`, `#22c55e`, `#ef4444`) — invisible dark mode theming is impossible.
- `border-2 border-slate-200` on billing card (settings, line 451) — hardcoded, breaks dark.
- Admin audit-log skeleton uses `bg-white` directly (line 61).

### Typography
**4 effective font sizes observed in use, plus 3 arbitrary ones:**
- `text-2xs` (custom 0.625rem) — used in sidebar badges, finding effort labels
- `text-xs` (0.75rem) — metadata, captions
- `text-sm` (0.875rem) — body text, most table content
- `text-base` (1rem) — some card titles
- `text-lg` — sparse
- `text-xl`, `text-2xl`, `text-3xl` — headings
- **Arbitrary:** `text-[10px]` and `text-[11px]` appear in 10+ places (admin badges, audit log, admin layout role label). No corresponding custom utility defined. Should map to `text-2xs` or be eliminated.
- **Arbitrary:** `text-[15px]` in `PageHeader.tsx` description text (line 16). Nothing in the scale corresponds. Should be `text-sm` (14px) or `text-base` (16px).
- `CardTitle` defaults to `text-2xl` in card.tsx — but most card titles override to `text-sm` or `text-base`. The component default is nearly never used, creating inconsistency between Card and custom page usage.

### Spacing
**Mostly consistent but with outliers:**
- Page padding: `p-6 md:p-8 lg:p-10` on main content (AppShell) and `p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8` on admin. Inconsistency between user and admin shell padding.
- KpiCard uses `p-6` inside `CardContent`. Most other cards also use `p-6` for `CardContent`. Consistent.
- `py-5` used on Button in LoginForm for extra-tall buttons (line 88, 152) — not on the 4px grid (`h-14` = 56px, `py-5` = 20px total vertical padding).
- `space-y-8` vs `space-y-6` used interchangeably at the same nesting level. Report page uses `space-y-8` for top-level sections; dashboard uses `space-y-6`. No defined rule.
- Scan page URL input field uses `h-14 rounded-xl` but the Select below it uses `h-12 rounded-xl` — inconsistent element heights in the same form.

### Radii
Currently 5 distinct radius values in active use (everything inflated because `--radius: 0.75rem`):
- `rounded-lg` (maps to `--radius-md` = 0.625rem)
- `rounded-xl` (maps to `--radius-xl` = 1rem)
- `rounded-2xl` (pure Tailwind — 1rem, same as xl — duplicate visual)
- `rounded-full` (pill)
- Explicit `rounded-none` on settings tabs

Post token-fix (`--radius: 0.5rem`), these map to: `rounded-lg`=0.375rem, `rounded-xl`=0.75rem — which is much tighter and more Vercel-like.

### Shadows
Token-defined soft shadows are good. However admin dashboard cards use `shadow-sm` (raw Tailwind) in multiple places (admin page lines 164, 177, etc.) while user-facing cards use `shadow-soft` (custom token). Two different shadow systems coexisting. QUICK WIN — standardize admin to `shadow-soft`.

### z-index
No custom z-index scale. Uses Tailwind defaults. No observed conflicts.

---

## 2. Component Consistency

### Primary button
**2 visual variants in use** — correct in design, but:
- Default size inconsistency: some CTAs use `h-14` (scan form), others use `h-10` (default), others use `h-9 sm` sizing — no rule for when to use large
- Report page "Re-scan" button is `size="sm"` (h-9) while "Share Score" is also `size="sm"` — consistent within header, but the header row with 5 different button sizes is cluttered

### Secondary/outline button
**Consistent.** `variant="outline"` used correctly throughout.

### Ghost button
**Mostly consistent** but overloaded — used for nav shortcuts ("New Scan" in header), for table row actions ("View"), and for CTA links ("View All"). These have different semantic weights but look identical.

### Input field
**2 distinct input heights exist in the scan form:**
- URL input: `h-14 rounded-xl` (56px tall)
- Select trigger: `h-12 rounded-xl` (48px tall)
These are in the same form card, side by side visually, and they don't match.

Standard inputs across the app use the default shadcn height (`h-10`). The mismatch only exists in the scan page form.

### Card
**3 variants exist without a pattern:**
- `border-border/40 shadow-soft` — most user-facing cards
- `border-border/50 shadow-soft` — settings, report page
- `border-border/50 shadow-sm` — admin cards (using raw Tailwind shadow)
These are visually near-identical but waste cognitive overhead in code review. The 0.40 vs 0.50 opacity difference is imperceptible at screen resolution.

### Badge/pill
**Most inconsistent component in the app.** Observed variants:
- Semantic status badges (completed/analyzing/failed) — inline `className` with hardcoded colors: `border-emerald-200/80 bg-emerald-50/50 text-emerald-700`
- Same status badges reproduced 3 separate times in 3 separate page files with slightly different opacity values
- Admin `text-[10px]` badges for audit log actions — 10px font, not using any token
- `text-2xs` custom utility on some badges, `text-xs` on others
- Effort badges in finding cards use `rounded-full` and `uppercase tracking-wide` — different shape language than other badges

No shared badge component for status, effort, severity. All composed inline per-page. REBUILD — extract `StatusBadge`, reuse everywhere.

### Empty state
**One shared component (`EmptyState`)** — correctly used in most places. GOOD. Three pages have inline custom empty states that don't use it (history page, audit log page, scan analysis gate wall).

### Loading skeleton
**Mostly per-page**, not a shared component. Each page defines its own skeleton layout. Skeletons generally match content shape — GOOD. Two issues:
- `DashboardSkeleton` uses `rounded-2xl` for the hero skeleton while the actual hero component is `rounded-xl` — minor mismatch
- Admin dashboard skeletons use `rounded-xl` but the stat cards beneath them are `rounded-xl` only by inline `rounded-xl` — relies on Tailwind, not the token system

### Dialog/modal
**Correct usage** — `Dialog` from shadcn used for form dialogs (PDFOptionsDialog, BulkScanDialog, invite). Share link is a `DropdownMenu`, which is correct for inline options.

### Sidebar nav item (active/hover/inactive)
**Both sidebars use identical patterns** — dark background (`oklch(11%)`), white text at varying opacity, left-border accent on active. This is intentional and consistent. GOOD.

The admin sidebar logo block has a redundant `"Admin"` label in tiny text below the logo — purely cosmetic, adds noise.

### Table row
**Consistent.** `hover:bg-muted/30` across all tables. The row-click pattern (reports page: full row clickable) vs button-click (dashboard: "View" button) is inconsistent but minor.

### Score ring / progress indicator
**ScoreRing** — well-built custom SVG component, consistent usage. GOOD.
**Progress** — used at 3 different heights: `h-1` (sidebar usage), `h-2` (most cards), `h-2` with color-override hack `[&>div]:bg-red-500` (settings billing). The `[&>div]` selector hack should be a proper variant.

---

## 3. Page-by-Page Problems

### Login / Signup / Auth pages
1. **Layout:** Left-form + right-testimonial panel only appears at `xl` breakpoint. At `lg`, users see the full form without any social proof. The breakpoint should be `lg`, not hidden until `xl`. QUICK WIN.
2. **Color:** Divider separator uses `bg-white` (line 108) — breaks dark mode. QUICK WIN — use `bg-background`.
3. **Typography:** `h1` uses `text-2xl font-bold` — too small for a primary auth heading by Linear/Vercel standards. Should be `text-3xl`. QUICK WIN.
4. **Spacing:** Form container is `max-w-sm` (384px) — fine. But vertical padding is `py-12` on the left column which makes it feel airy on tall screens without providing more information.
5. **Missing state:** No loading skeleton while `useAuth` resolves — the page renders the form before redirecting authenticated users, causing a visible flash. REBUILD — gate render on auth check.

### Dashboard
1. **Information density:** 5 KPI cards + hero + action strip + 2 charts + table + quick wins = 7 distinct sections with no visual grouping or breathing room between conceptual sections. All use `space-y-6` uniformly — no hierarchy signal. REBUILD — group into 2-3 visual zones.
2. **Typography:** `CardTitle` inside the "Recent Scans" card is `text-sm font-medium` — treating the table title at the same visual weight as regular body text. Use `text-base font-semibold`. QUICK WIN.
3. **Spacing:** The right column "Quick Scan" card has a `h-[2px]` gradient accent line at the top — a decorative flourish that has no meaning but looks like a loading indicator. Remove or standardize with a border-primary treatment. QUICK WIN.
4. **Layout:** 5 KPI cards in `lg:grid-cols-5` — 5 equal columns is extremely wide-padded at 1200px max-width. Cards look sparse. Consider `lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5` or 2+3 layout. REBUILD.
5. **Mobile:** At sm, 5 cards stack vertically consuming 500px before users see any content. REBUILD — limit to 2 most important KPIs on mobile.

### Scan page
1. **Form inconsistency:** URL input `h-14` vs Select trigger `h-12` in the same card. QUICK WIN — normalize to `h-11` or `h-12` both.
2. **Layout:** CTA at the bottom reads "Analyze Free — No Sign Up Needed" for guests, "Start Analysis" for auth users, "Scan limit reached — Upgrade to continue" when at limit. Each renders a different button width and text. On auth users the button icon placement changes (icon precedes text vs inline in different branches). QUICK WIN — unify button template.
3. **Color:** The "How scoring works" info card uses `bg-primary/[0.02]` — this is imperceptibly different from `bg-background`. The card is invisible. Use `bg-muted/40` instead. QUICK WIN.
4. **Typography:** `h3` "7 pillars we analyze" uses `text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground` — this heading style is overused across the app (appears in reports page and admin) and should be a named utility. Also `tracking-widest` with `text-xs` is visually labored. QUICK WIN.
5. **Missing state:** BrowserFrame loading animation uses an undefined `animate-[shimmer_1.5s_ease-in-out_infinite]` — no `shimmer` keyframe is defined in globals.css. This animation silently fails. QUICK WIN — replace with `animate-pulse` or define the keyframe.

### Reports/[id] (Audit Report)
1. **Header action area is overloaded:** "Share Score" + "PDF Coming Soon" (a Badge, not a Button) + "Share" dropdown + "Re-scan" = 4 elements at sm breakpoints they stack or overflow. The "PDF Coming Soon" badge masquerading as a button-height element is especially confusing. REBUILD — consolidate into a Share dropdown + Re-scan primary.
2. **Tabs overflow:** The `TabsList` in "Detailed Findings" is `flex flex-wrap` — on screens under 1024px the tabs wrap unpredictably, creating 2-3 rows. Use horizontal scroll instead. QUICK WIN.
3. **Hardcoded colors:** Browser mockup wireframe uses `slate-200/80`, `slate-200/60`, `blue-200/40`, `blue-300/30` — all hardcoded, break dark mode. REBUILD dark-mode-safe version using `bg-muted` variants.
4. **Color:** `text-slate-500` on breadcrumb span (line 474). Should be `text-muted-foreground`. QUICK WIN.
5. **Animation:** All ANNOTATION_DOTS pulse `animate-pulse` simultaneously — creates visual noise. The pulsing should be staggered or removed entirely. QUICK WIN — remove animate-pulse, keep hover tooltip.

### My Reports (reports list)
1. **Layout:** Filter bar (Card with full `p-4`) wrapping 4 select inputs looks heavy. A lighter treatment (no card, just a flex row with a subtle separator) fits the Linear aesthetic better. REBUILD.
2. **Mobile:** 7-column table with `overflow-x-auto` — on mobile users see 2 truncated columns and must scroll horizontally for all others. Should show 3 columns max on mobile: website, score, action. REBUILD.
3. **Typography:** `text-2xs` for bulk job status text (line 249) — too small for content that informs the user of job results. QUICK WIN — use `text-xs`.
4. **Missing state:** No pagination — all scans load at once. With 50+ scans this becomes unusable. REBUILD — add pagination or virtual scroll.
5. **Color:** `bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700` / `bg-red-50 text-red-700` for bulk job status — hardcoded, same pattern repeated across 8 different files. QUICK WIN — extract shared token.

### History page
1. **Typography:** Inline `h1` heading bypasses `PageHeader` component — inconsistency with every other page. QUICK WIN — use `PageHeader`.
2. **Layout:** 2-column card grid on `md+` is good, but each card has a mini sparkline chart inside — the sparkline height (60px) is too small to convey meaningful trends. QUICK WIN — raise to 80px.
3. **Missing state:** Error state is missing entirely — `isError` is not handled in the page. If the query fails, the page silently renders an empty state instead of an error recovery UI. REBUILD.
4. **Motion:** Uses `framer-motion` (`motion.div`) with stagger — correct and works well. KEEP.
5. **Color:** The DeltaChip `bg-green-100 text-green-700` / `bg-red-100 text-red-600` are hardcoded — inconsistent with how severity colors work elsewhere. QUICK WIN.

### Settings page
1. **Billing card:** `border-2 border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 to-white` — fully hardcoded, breaks dark mode completely. The billing hero card looks like a different product in dark mode. REBUILD.
2. **Typography:** Plan comparison table uses raw `<table>` / `<thead>` / `<tbody>` instead of shadcn `Table` component — inconsistency with every other data table. QUICK WIN — migrate.
3. **Color:** Badge classes for "closed" and "pending" support statuses use `bg-slate-100 text-slate-600` — hardcoded, bypasses token system. QUICK WIN.
4. **Spacing:** Settings tabs use `border-b-2 border-transparent` active indicator — the tab bar sits against the card header, creating two horizontal rules (tab bottom border + card top border) that are visually confusing. REBUILD — use `bg-card` or more separation.
5. **Mobile:** `sm:grid-cols-2` form fields stack correctly. Password change form with nested border box is fine. The billing `min-w-[480px]` plan comparison table forces horizontal scroll on mobile — no min-width escape. QUICK WIN — add `overflow-x-auto` wrapper.

### Admin Dashboard
1. **Two separate KPI sections:** Admin page renders TWO separate 4-column grids back-to-back (lines 127 and 162) with a second loading/error check. This is architecturally fragile and visually creates a 4+4 card double-row that looks unintentional. REBUILD — merge into one 8-card grid or 2×4 section with a visual divider.
2. **Mixed shadow:** Charts use `border-border/50 shadow-sm` while KPI cards use raw inline styles. No `shadow-soft`. QUICK WIN.
3. **Hardcoded chart colors:** `stroke="#6366f1"`, `fill="#818cf8"` in AreaChart, `fill="#22c55e"` in BarChart — hardcoded hex, not using CSS variables. Dark mode chart theming is broken. REBUILD — use `hsl(var(--primary))` family.
4. **Typography:** Inline stat cards (lines 164–219) replicate KpiCard's structure manually — a second KPI card component created in the same file. REBUILD — use `KpiCard` throughout.
5. **Audit feed:** The activity feed at bottom is the most useful element but is buried after 2 KPI grids and 2 charts. Reorder: activity feed first (or in right sidebar) with KPIs above. REBUILD.

### Admin Users/Scans/Support/Billing (shared issues)
1. All admin pages have inconsistent padding between them: some use `p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8`, admin shell uses same values but the actual max-width differs (1140px admin vs 1200px app). QUICK WIN — unify.
2. `text-[10px]` badge font size used throughout admin tables. Not on any scale. QUICK WIN — use `text-2xs` or `text-xs`.
3. Admin feature flags page: success toast "Saved" uses a raw green inline banner (line 87) instead of sonner toast — inconsistent notification system. QUICK WIN.

---

## 4. Sidebar + Top Bar

### User sidebar
Well-structured. Dark background, icon + label, left-accent active state. Clean collapse-to-icon behavior.

**Issues:**
- No section grouping. 10 nav items are flat. Items "Refer & Earn", "API", "Monitoring" are secondary features mixed with primary ones (Dashboard, New Scan, Reports). Should be grouped: Primary (Dashboard, New Scan, Reports, Score History) / Tools (Competitors, Monitoring, Integrations) / Account (API, Referrals, Settings). REBUILD — add `SidebarGroupLabel`.
- Scan usage indicator and "Upgrade Plan" CTA in sidebar footer — good. But the `Badge` showing plan name uses `text-2xs` with `border-white/10` which is near-invisible. QUICK WIN — use `text-xs` and slightly higher contrast.
- No tooltip for the Upgrade Plan icon-only button in collapsed state (only an `aria-label`). shadcn Sidebar `tooltip` prop exists on `SidebarMenuButton` — not used here. QUICK WIN.

### Admin sidebar
Uses same visual treatment as user sidebar — correct, intentional product decision. 

**Issues:**
- "Admin" sub-label in the logo block (10px, white/30 opacity) — hard to read at any size. Remove it or make it an `AdminBadge` in the header bar instead. QUICK WIN.
- "Back to App" in footer is `text-white/40` — almost invisible. Users need this link. Raise contrast to `text-white/70`. QUICK WIN.
- No item grouping (same issue as user sidebar). 9 flat items. Could be: Overview / Users & Data / Platform / System. REBUILD.

### Top bar (AppHeader)
Clean. Breadcrumb, New Scan shortcut, user menu. 

**Issues:**
- Breadcrumb shows "Detail" for deep pages like `/reports/:id` — this is the generic fallback label. On the report detail page it should show the page title (truncated). The `detailPageLabels` map only covers 3 routes. QUICK WIN — pass page title via context or search param.
- "New Scan" button is `hidden sm:flex` — invisible on mobile. There's no mobile equivalent. REBUILD — move to a floating action button on mobile or show in hamburger.
- No mobile hamburger. The `SidebarTrigger` (hamburger icon) is always visible and does trigger the drawer — but the trigger has no visual affordance or label. Paired with no aria context it's a bare icon at 14px. QUICK WIN — ensure touch target is 44×44.

---

## 5. Critical UX Gaps

### Missing loading skeletons
- `app/r/[token]` (public share) — no skeleton, renders empty while loading
- `app/invite/[token]` — no skeleton
- `/monitoring` — not checked but likely no skeleton (feature is premium-gated, may be a stub)
- `/referrals` — has inline `Skeleton` for the table but the stat cards above render without data then jump, no skeleton block for them

### Missing empty states
- `/history` — has custom inline empty state but it's not the shared component (inconsistent visual)
- `/api-settings` — API keys tab shows premium lock, but no empty state if lock is bypassed for agency users
- `/monitoring` — unclear if implemented
- Admin `/admin/users/[userId]` — scan history section likely has no empty state for new users

### Missing error boundaries
- No page-level `ErrorBoundary` wrapping observed except `ChartErrorBoundary` (charts only)
- `/history` page: no `isError` handler — silent failure on query error
- Admin pages: several use inline `role="alert"` divs for error — not a boundary

### Broken mobile breakpoints
- Reports table: 7 columns → horizontal scroll only. Should hide columns on mobile
- Pricing page: comparison table has `min-w-[480px]` — enforces scroll. Acceptable but needs `overflow-x-auto` wrapper (may be missing)
- Dashboard 5-KPI grid: `sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5` — at tablet (768px) shows 2+3 split, middle card alone on row 3. Odd layout.
- Auth page testimonial panel: hidden until `xl` (1280px) — users on 1024px laptop see only the form with large whitespace

### Accessibility
- `*:focus-visible` global focus ring defined in globals.css — GOOD
- Icon-only collapsed sidebar buttons use `aria-label` — GOOD on Upgrade link, less consistent elsewhere
- `SidebarTrigger` has no visible label on mobile — touch target is the hamburger icon which may be under 44px
- `text-[10px]` admin badges fail WCAG AA at nearly every background color combination (10px is below the 14px threshold for normal text, requiring 4.5:1 ratio against small backgrounds)
- Login form Google button SVG `<svg>` lacks `aria-hidden="true"` — may announce to screen readers
- FindingCard premium blur: `blur-sm pointer-events-none` on text content (settings API key code line) — screen readers can still read blurred content but sighted users cannot — inconsistency
- `formatDate` locale is hardcoded `"en-US"` throughout — no i18n consideration (low priority, note for future)

---

## 6. What's Good — Preserve This

- **Token system architecture** — OKLCH-based semantic palette, dark mode split, sidebar tokens — the foundation is correct. Needs fixes (see above) but the structure is right.
- **`EmptyState` shared component** — icon + title + description + optional CTA, properly used on most pages.
- **`ScoreRing` SVG component** — clean, reusable, used consistently in every score-adjacent view.
- **`PageTransition` wrapper** — consistent fade-in on route change using `animate-fade-in`. Subtle, professional.
- **`ChartErrorBoundary`** — correct use of error boundary for chart-specific failures.
- **Sidebar collapse behavior** — icon-mode fallback, `SidebarTrigger`, tooltip support all wired via shadcn primitives.
- **Scan page analysis view** — progress bar + timeline + BrowserFrame combination is a well-designed loading experience. Keep the structure.
- **Breadcrumb in AppHeader** — presence and logic is good, just needs the detail-page label fix.
- **`useScan` polling pattern** — 2s refetch with redirect on complete is clean UX.
- **KpiCard component** — proper semantic structure, trend indicator, icon slot. Well-built.
- **Accessible form patterns in scan page** — `useId`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `role="alert"` on error — correct a11y.
- **History page Framer Motion stagger** — subtle, well-timed. Keep it.
- **shadcn `Tabs` underline variant in Settings** — custom `border-b-2` tab style is a clean departure from the default pill tabs. Keep the pattern but fix the color consistency.
- **Sonner toast integration** — `richColors`, `closeButton`, `duration=4000` — professional defaults.

---

Given the scope (token fix + 10+ page rebuilds + new StatusBadge + sidebar grouping + streaming scan + Cmd+K + chart color theming + dark mode fixes), I'll split this into two parallel workstreams:

21. **Global search & replace** all hardcoded colors — `bg-white`, `bg-slate-*`, `border-slate-*`, `text-slate-*`, `#6366f1`, `#22c55e`, `#ef4444`, `emerald-*`, `amber-*`, `red-500` outside of token-mapped contexts. Replace with token-driven classes.
22. **Delete** `--color-accent` == `--color-secondary` dead-code per spec.
23. **Fix** `text-[15px]`, `text-[10px]`, `text-[11px]` → use new scale.
24. **Ensure** `pnpm typecheck` is clean.
25. **Ensure** `pnpm build` is clean. Standalone bundle output intact for Railway.

## Quality bar
- TypeScript strict — no `any`
- No commented-out code
- No TODOs left behind
- Every Recharts usage uses `useChartColors()` — grep for hex in Recharts after you finish, should return zero
- Every status indicator in the app uses `StatusBadge` or the new `Badge` — no inline `bg-emerald-100` strings
- Dark mode works on EVERY page — no `bg-white` or `bg-slate-*` raw usages anywhere in `app/` or `components/`
- `globals.css` is the single source of color truth

## Do NOT
- Do NOT delete functional components without replacement
- Do NOT rename routes or break URL structure
- Do NOT touch `supabase/`, `middleware.ts`, `lib/supabase/*`, `lib/score-utils.ts`, `lib/constants.ts` business logic
- Do NOT touch `next.config.ts`, `railway.json`, `nixpacks.toml`
- Do NOT add new dependencies beyond what's in `package.json` — cmdk, framer-motion, shadcn primitives, sonner, lucide-react, recharts are all already installed

## When done
- Report what you changed (file list + summary)
- Report `pnpm typecheck` output (should be clean)
- Report `pnpm build` output (should succeed)
- Note any deferred items that couldn't be done in this pass

This is a large ticket — estimate 30+ file edits. Be thorough. Quality over speed.

# Playwright-Driven Full UI/UX QA Sweep + Agent-Routed Fixes

## Context

CROBOT (ConvertScan) just received a 73-file Linear/Vercel/Resend design-system rebuild — new tokens, dark mode, CommandPalette, streaming scan log, grouped sidebars, rebuilt pages. Typecheck + build are clean and it's shipped to `crobot.up.railway.app`.

But the app has never been exercised by an automated browser. Dark-mode leaks, broken responsive breakpoints, console errors, a11y violations, and interaction bugs only surface when a real browser clicks through. This pass installs Playwright, does a full sweep (screenshots × themes × viewports + interaction flows + a11y + console), routes findings to the correct specialist agent, ships fixes, re-runs the sweep until clean.

Target: zero BLOCKING issues and zero P1 visual regressions before we consider the rebuild "done."

## Scope

- **20 routes** to exercise: 7 public (login, signup, forgot/reset password, privacy, terms, `/r/[token]`), 11 authed user pages, 10 admin pages, 1 health API
- **3 viewports**: mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1440×900
- **2 themes**: light + dark (toggle via `data-theme` on `<html>` since app uses `next-themes`)
- **4 interaction flows**: signup flow, Cmd+K palette, new-scan submit, sidebar navigation
- **A11y + console**: `@axe-core/playwright` per page, `page.on('console')` capture per test
- **Both environments**: smoke subset on Railway prod, full sweep locally

## Approach

### Phase 0 — Prerequisites

1. Install test deps: `pnpm add -D @playwright/test @axe-core/playwright`
2. `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` (skip firefox/webkit — chromium covers 95% of UX issues and keeps run time sane)
3. Add scripts to `package.json`:
   - `test:e2e` → `playwright test`
   - `test:e2e:ui` → `playwright test --ui` (interactive mode for debugging)
   - `test:e2e:smoke` → `playwright test --grep @smoke` (Railway-only subset)

### Phase 1 — Test harness

Files to create:

- `playwright.config.ts` at repo root
  - `webServer`: `pnpm dev`, `url: http://localhost:3000`, reuse if already running
  - `projects`: `desktop-chrome` (1440×900), `tablet-chrome` (768×1024), `mobile-chrome` (375×812)
  - `use.trace: 'retain-on-failure'`, `use.screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`
  - `reporter`: `[['html'], ['list']]`
  - Two base URLs via env: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000` default, `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app` for smoke
- `e2e/global-setup.ts`
  - Creates a test user via Supabase admin API using `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` from `.env.local`: `playwright+{timestamp}@convertscan.dev` / auto-generated password
  - Writes storage state (authed session cookie) to `e2e/.auth/user.json`
  - Tests that need auth load storage state via `use({ storageState: 'e2e/.auth/user.json' })`
- `e2e/global-teardown.ts`
  - Deletes the test user via admin API after the run (cleanup)
- `e2e/helpers/`
  - `routes.ts` — exported list of routes (public + authed + admin)
  - `visual.ts` — `capturePage(page, name)` helper that snapshots light + dark and dumps to `test-results/screenshots/{theme}/{viewport}/{route}.png`
  - `a11y.ts` — `auditA11y(page)` wrapper around `@axe-core/playwright` that ignores known false positives
  - `console.ts` — `captureConsole(page)` collects errors/warnings, attaches to test via `testInfo.attach()`

Reuses existing infra:
- `supabase/functions/` and cloud project for the test user
- `.env.local` for `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` uses `next-themes` — tests flip theme by setting `localStorage.theme` or clicking the theme toggle

### Phase 2 — Test suites

Five spec files in `e2e/`:

1. **`visual-sweep.spec.ts`** — loops every route in `routes.ts`, `capturePage()` at each viewport × theme. No assertions other than "page loaded without error + no axe violations above serious." This is the volume-producer; ~120 screenshots/run.
2. **`auth-flow.spec.ts`** — landing → signup → dashboard. Checks redirect from `/` to `/login`, form validation, redirect to `/dashboard` on success, session persists on reload.
3. **`scan-flow.spec.ts`** — dashboard → `/scan` → paste URL → submit → verify streaming log panel renders → wait for report or mock-complete state.
4. **`nav-flow.spec.ts`** — Cmd+K palette opens, sidebar collapse/expand works, every sidebar item navigates, admin ↔ user mode switch.
5. **`smoke.spec.ts`** — tagged `@smoke`, runs against `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app`. Just: loads `/login`, loads `/api/health`, no 5xx.

### Phase 3 — Run + triage

1. `pnpm test:e2e` locally → generates `test-results/` with screenshots, `playwright-report/` HTML report
2. I read the report summary (not raw screenshots — too large for context) and categorize failures:
   - **BLOCKING**: 500 errors, unrecoverable crashes, CSP violations
   - **VISUAL P1**: dark-mode breakage, broken responsive, unreadable contrast
   - **VISUAL P2**: alignment nits, spacing inconsistencies, minor polish
   - **A11Y**: axe violations by severity
   - **CONSOLE**: browser console errors / unhandled promise rejections
3. Route findings to agents by category:
   - BLOCKING → 🐛 Vex (root-cause fix)
   - VISUAL P1/P2 → 🎨 Vega (spec change if needed) → ⚡ Koda (implement)
   - A11Y → Koda with Sage gating
   - CONSOLE → Vex triage → Koda fix
4. Agents work in parallel where files don't overlap.

### Phase 4 — Re-run until clean

Loop: fix → `pnpm test:e2e` → triage remaining → fix. Exit when:
- Zero failing tests
- Zero axe `serious`/`critical` violations
- Zero uncaught console errors (warnings allowed with justification)

Bound: max 3 fix cycles. If issue count doesn't trend toward zero by cycle 3, stop and surface a summary to you for scope decision.

### Phase 5 — Commit + push + Railway smoke

1. Single commit: `test: add Playwright e2e harness + fix [N] regressions found`
2. Push to `origin/main` → Railway rebuilds
3. Run `pnpm test:e2e:smoke` against Railway once deploy is green
4. Final report: what was found, what was fixed, remaining known issues

## Critical files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `playwright.config.ts` | NEW — Playwright config, viewports, webServer |
| `e2e/global-setup.ts` | NEW — creates Supabase test user, stores session |
| `e2e/global-teardown.ts` | NEW — cleanup test user |
| `e2e/helpers/{routes,visual,a11y,console}.ts` | NEW — reusable test helpers |
| `e2e/{visual-sweep,auth-flow,scan-flow,nav-flow,smoke}.spec.ts` | NEW — 5 test suites |
| `package.json` | MODIFY — add test:e2e scripts + deps |
| `.gitignore` | MODIFY — ignore `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, `e2e/.auth/` |
| `tsconfig.json` | MODIFY — include `e2e/**/*.ts` in compile scope |
| `.env.example` | MODIFY — document `BASE_URL` for smoke mode |

## Reusable existing code

- `lib/supabase/server.ts` — has `createServiceRoleClient()` pattern we'll mirror in `global-setup.ts`
- `.env.local` already has `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` for the Supabase admin auth user create
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` — `next-themes` wrapper, tests flip theme by `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')` or `localStorage.setItem('theme','dark')`
- `nixpacks.toml` stays unchanged — Playwright never runs on Railway, only locally

## Verification

1. `pnpm exec playwright --version` prints a version
2. `pnpm test:e2e` runs end-to-end, produces `playwright-report/index.html`
3. `pnpm exec playwright show-report` opens the report in browser — every route has a screenshot row
4. `test-results/screenshots/{light,dark}/{desktop,tablet,mobile}/` directories populated with ~120 PNGs
5. After fix cycles: `pnpm test:e2e` exits 0, zero serious/critical axe violations, zero console errors
6. Smoke: `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app pnpm test:e2e:smoke` exits 0 after Railway deploy

## Out of scope

- Cross-browser testing (Firefox/WebKit) — Chromium only this pass
- Visual regression diffing (pixel-by-pixel baseline) — later pass, needs stable screenshots first
- Load testing, performance budgets — use Hawk separately if needed
- Supabase function runtime testing — functions tested in isolation, not via this sweep
- Real payment flows (Dodo) — mocked or skipped

## Guardrails

- Test user is created fresh each run, deleted on teardown. No pollution in Supabase.
- Storage state file `e2e/.auth/user.json` is gitignored — never committed.
- Smoke tests run read-only on Railway — no data writes, no new users, no scans.
- If Railway smoke discovers a bug that local doesn't reproduce, Vex investigates (likely env-var drift).
- `--grep @smoke` for Railway, default full suite for local — prevents accidental prod writes.

# Playwright-Driven Full UI/UX QA Sweep + Agent-Routed Fixes

## Context

CROBOT (ConvertScan) just received a 73-file Linear/Vercel/Resend design-system rebuild — new tokens, dark mode, CommandPalette, streaming scan log, grouped sidebars, rebuilt pages. Typecheck + build are clean and it's shipped to `crobot.up.railway.app`.

But the app has never been exercised by an automated browser. Dark-mode leaks, broken responsive breakpoints, console errors, a11y violations, and interaction bugs only surface when a real browser clicks through. This pass installs Playwright, does a full sweep (screenshots × themes × viewports + interaction flows + a11y + console), routes findings to the correct specialist agent, ships fixes, re-runs the sweep until clean.

Target: zero BLOCKING issues and zero P1 visual regressions before we consider the rebuild "done."

## Scope

- **20 routes** to exercise: 7 public (login, signup, forgot/reset password, privacy, terms, `/r/[token]`), 11 authed user pages, 10 admin pages, 1 health API
- **3 viewports**: mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1440×900
- **2 themes**: light + dark (toggle via `data-theme` on `<html>` since app uses `next-themes`)
- **4 interaction flows**: signup flow, Cmd+K palette, new-scan submit, sidebar navigation
- **A11y + console**: `@axe-core/playwright` per page, `page.on('console')` capture per test
- **Both environments**: smoke subset on Railway prod, full sweep locally

## Approach

### Phase 0 — Prerequisites

1. Install test deps: `pnpm add -D @playwright/test @axe-core/playwright`
2. `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` (skip firefox/webkit — chromium covers 95% of UX issues and keeps run time sane)
3. Add scripts to `package.json`:
   - `test:e2e` → `playwright test`
   - `test:e2e:ui` → `playwright test --ui` (interactive mode for debugging)
   - `test:e2e:smoke` → `playwright test --grep @smoke` (Railway-only subset)

### Phase 1 — Test harness

Files to create:

- `playwright.config.ts` at repo root
  - `webServer`: `pnpm dev`, `url: http://localhost:3000`, reuse if already running
  - `projects`: `desktop-chrome` (1440×900), `tablet-chrome` (768×1024), `mobile-chrome` (375×812)
  - `use.trace: 'retain-on-failure'`, `use.screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`
  - `reporter`: `[['html'], ['list']]`
  - Two base URLs via env: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000` default, `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app` for smoke
- `e2e/global-setup.ts`
  - Creates a test user via Supabase admin API using `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` from `.env.local`: `playwright+{timestamp}@convertscan.dev` / auto-generated password
  - Writes storage state (authed session cookie) to `e2e/.auth/user.json`
  - Tests that need auth load storage state via `use({ storageState: 'e2e/.auth/user.json' })`
- `e2e/global-teardown.ts`
  - Deletes the test user via admin API after the run (cleanup)
- `e2e/helpers/`
  - `routes.ts` — exported list of routes (public + authed + admin)
  - `visual.ts` — `capturePage(page, name)` helper that snapshots light + dark and dumps to `test-results/screenshots/{theme}/{viewport}/{route}.png`
  - `a11y.ts` — `auditA11y(page)` wrapper around `@axe-core/playwright` that ignores known false positives
  - `console.ts` — `captureConsole(page)` collects errors/warnings, attaches to test via `testInfo.attach()`

Reuses existing infra:
- `supabase/functions/` and cloud project for the test user
- `.env.local` for `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` uses `next-themes` — tests flip theme by setting `localStorage.theme` or clicking the theme toggle

### Phase 2 — Test suites

Five spec files in `e2e/`:

1. **`visual-sweep.spec.ts`** — loops every route in `routes.ts`, `capturePage()` at each viewport × theme. No assertions other than "page loaded without error + no axe violations above serious." This is the volume-producer; ~120 screenshots/run.
2. **`auth-flow.spec.ts`** — landing → signup → dashboard. Checks redirect from `/` to `/login`, form validation, redirect to `/dashboard` on success, session persists on reload.
3. **`scan-flow.spec.ts`** — dashboard → `/scan` → paste URL → submit → verify streaming log panel renders → wait for report or mock-complete state.
4. **`nav-flow.spec.ts`** — Cmd+K palette opens, sidebar collapse/expand works, every sidebar item navigates, admin ↔ user mode switch.
5. **`smoke.spec.ts`** — tagged `@smoke`, runs against `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app`. Just: loads `/login`, loads `/api/health`, no 5xx.

### Phase 3 — Run + triage

1. `pnpm test:e2e` locally → generates `test-results/` with screenshots, `playwright-report/` HTML report
2. I read the report summary (not raw screenshots — too large for context) and categorize failures:
   - **BLOCKING**: 500 errors, unrecoverable crashes, CSP violations
   - **VISUAL P1**: dark-mode breakage, broken responsive, unreadable contrast
   - **VISUAL P2**: alignment nits, spacing inconsistencies, minor polish
   - **A11Y**: axe violations by severity
   - **CONSOLE**: browser console errors / unhandled promise rejections
3. Route findings to agents by category:
   - BLOCKING → 🐛 Vex (root-cause fix)
   - VISUAL P1/P2 → 🎨 Vega (spec change if needed) → ⚡ Koda (implement)
   - A11Y → Koda with Sage gating
   - CONSOLE → Vex triage → Koda fix
4. Agents work in parallel where files don't overlap.

### Phase 4 — Re-run until clean

Loop: fix → `pnpm test:e2e` → triage remaining → fix. Exit when:
- Zero failing tests
- Zero axe `serious`/`critical` violations
- Zero uncaught console errors (warnings allowed with justification)

Bound: max 3 fix cycles. If issue count doesn't trend toward zero by cycle 3, stop and surface a summary to you for scope decision.

### Phase 5 — Commit + push + Railway smoke

1. Single commit: `test: add Playwright e2e harness + fix [N] regressions found`
2. Push to `origin/main` → Railway rebuilds
3. Run `pnpm test:e2e:smoke` against Railway once deploy is green
4. Final report: what was found, what was fixed, remaining known issues

## Critical files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `playwright.config.ts` | NEW — Playwright config, viewports, webServer |
| `e2e/global-setup.ts` | NEW — creates Supabase test user, stores session |
| `e2e/global-teardown.ts` | NEW — cleanup test user |
| `e2e/helpers/{routes,visual,a11y,console}.ts` | NEW — reusable test helpers |
| `e2e/{visual-sweep,auth-flow,scan-flow,nav-flow,smoke}.spec.ts` | NEW — 5 test suites |
| `package.json` | MODIFY — add test:e2e scripts + deps |
| `.gitignore` | MODIFY — ignore `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, `e2e/.auth/` |
| `tsconfig.json` | MODIFY — include `e2e/**/*.ts` in compile scope |
| `.env.example` | MODIFY — document `BASE_URL` for smoke mode |

## Reusable existing code

- `lib/supabase/server.ts` — has `createServiceRoleClient()` pattern we'll mirror in `global-setup.ts`
- `.env.local` already has `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` for the Supabase admin auth user create
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` — `next-themes` wrapper, tests flip theme by `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')` or `localStorage.setItem('theme','dark')`
- `nixpacks.toml` stays unchanged — Playwright never runs on Railway, only locally

## Verification

1. `pnpm exec playwright --version` prints a version
2. `pnpm test:e2e` runs end-to-end, produces `playwright-report/index.html`
3. `pnpm exec playwright show-report` opens the report in browser — every route has a screenshot row
4. `test-results/screenshots/{light,dark}/{desktop,tablet,mobile}/` directories populated with ~120 PNGs
5. After fix cycles: `pnpm test:e2e` exits 0, zero serious/critical axe violations, zero console errors
6. Smoke: `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app pnpm test:e2e:smoke` exits 0 after Railway deploy

## Out of scope

- Cross-browser testing (Firefox/WebKit) — Chromium only this pass
- Visual regression diffing (pixel-by-pixel baseline) — later pass, needs stable screenshots first
- Load testing, performance budgets — use Hawk separately if needed
- Supabase function runtime testing — functions tested in isolation, not via this sweep
- Real payment flows (Dodo) — mocked or skipped

## Guardrails

- Test user is created fresh each run, deleted on teardown. No pollution in Supabase.
- Storage state file `e2e/.auth/user.json` is gitignored — never committed.
- Smoke tests run read-only on Railway — no data writes, no new users, no scans.
- If Railway smoke discovers a bug that local doesn't reproduce, Vex investigates (likely env-var drift).
- `--grep @smoke` for Railway, default full suite for local — prevents accidental prod writes.

# Playwright-Driven Full UI/UX QA Sweep + Agent-Routed Fixes

## Context

CROBOT (ConvertScan) just received a 73-file Linear/Vercel/Resend design-system rebuild — new tokens, dark mode, CommandPalette, streaming scan log, grouped sidebars, rebuilt pages. Typecheck + build are clean and it's shipped to `crobot.up.railway.app`.

But the app has never been exercised by an automated browser. Dark-mode leaks, broken responsive breakpoints, console errors, a11y violations, and interaction bugs only surface when a real browser clicks through. This pass installs Playwright, does a full sweep (screenshots × themes × viewports + interaction flows + a11y + console), routes findings to the correct specialist agent, ships fixes, re-runs the sweep until clean.

Target: zero BLOCKING issues and zero P1 visual regressions before we consider the rebuild "done."

## Scope

- **20 routes** to exercise: 7 public (login, signup, forgot/reset password, privacy, terms, `/r/[token]`), 11 authed user pages, 10 admin pages, 1 health API
- **3 viewports**: mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1440×900
- **2 themes**: light + dark (toggle via `data-theme` on `<html>` since app uses `next-themes`)
- **4 interaction flows**: signup flow, Cmd+K palette, new-scan submit, sidebar navigation
- **A11y + console**: `@axe-core/playwright` per page, `page.on('console')` capture per test
- **Both environments**: smoke subset on Railway prod, full sweep locally

## Approach

### Phase 0 — Prerequisites

1. Install test deps: `pnpm add -D @playwright/test @axe-core/playwright`
2. `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` (skip firefox/webkit — chromium covers 95% of UX issues and keeps run time sane)
3. Add scripts to `package.json`:
   - `test:e2e` → `playwright test`
   - `test:e2e:ui` → `playwright test --ui` (interactive mode for debugging)
   - `test:e2e:smoke` → `playwright test --grep @smoke` (Railway-only subset)

### Phase 1 — Test harness

Files to create:

- `playwright.config.ts` at repo root
  - `webServer`: `pnpm dev`, `url: http://localhost:3000`, reuse if already running
  - `projects`: `desktop-chrome` (1440×900), `tablet-chrome` (768×1024), `mobile-chrome` (375×812)
  - `use.trace: 'retain-on-failure'`, `use.screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`
  - `reporter`: `[['html'], ['list']]`
  - Two base URLs via env: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000` default, `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app` for smoke
- `e2e/global-setup.ts`
  - Creates a test user via Supabase admin API using `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` from `.env.local`: `playwright+{timestamp}@convertscan.dev` / auto-generated password
  - Writes storage state (authed session cookie) to `e2e/.auth/user.json`
  - Tests that need auth load storage state via `use({ storageState: 'e2e/.auth/user.json' })`
- `e2e/global-teardown.ts`
  - Deletes the test user via admin API after the run (cleanup)
- `e2e/helpers/`
  - `routes.ts` — exported list of routes (public + authed + admin)
  - `visual.ts` — `capturePage(page, name)` helper that snapshots light + dark and dumps to `test-results/screenshots/{theme}/{viewport}/{route}.png`
  - `a11y.ts` — `auditA11y(page)` wrapper around `@axe-core/playwright` that ignores known false positives
  - `console.ts` — `captureConsole(page)` collects errors/warnings, attaches to test via `testInfo.attach()`

Reuses existing infra:
- `supabase/functions/` and cloud project for the test user
- `.env.local` for `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` uses `next-themes` — tests flip theme by setting `localStorage.theme` or clicking the theme toggle

### Phase 2 — Test suites

Five spec files in `e2e/`:

1. **`visual-sweep.spec.ts`** — loops every route in `routes.ts`, `capturePage()` at each viewport × theme. No assertions other than "page loaded without error + no axe violations above serious." This is the volume-producer; ~120 screenshots/run.
2. **`auth-flow.spec.ts`** — landing → signup → dashboard. Checks redirect from `/` to `/login`, form validation, redirect to `/dashboard` on success, session persists on reload.
3. **`scan-flow.spec.ts`** — dashboard → `/scan` → paste URL → submit → verify streaming log panel renders → wait for report or mock-complete state.
4. **`nav-flow.spec.ts`** — Cmd+K palette opens, sidebar collapse/expand works, every sidebar item navigates, admin ↔ user mode switch.
5. **`smoke.spec.ts`** — tagged `@smoke`, runs against `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app`. Just: loads `/login`, loads `/api/health`, no 5xx.

### Phase 3 — Run + triage

1. `pnpm test:e2e` locally → generates `test-results/` with screenshots, `playwright-report/` HTML report
2. I read the report summary (not raw screenshots — too large for context) and categorize failures:
   - **BLOCKING**: 500 errors, unrecoverable crashes, CSP violations
   - **VISUAL P1**: dark-mode breakage, broken responsive, unreadable contrast
   - **VISUAL P2**: alignment nits, spacing inconsistencies, minor polish
   - **A11Y**: axe violations by severity
   - **CONSOLE**: browser console errors / unhandled promise rejections
3. Route findings to agents by category:
   - BLOCKING → 🐛 Vex (root-cause fix)
   - VISUAL P1/P2 → 🎨 Vega (spec change if needed) → ⚡ Koda (implement)
   - A11Y → Koda with Sage gating
   - CONSOLE → Vex triage → Koda fix
4. Agents work in parallel where files don't overlap.

### Phase 4 — Re-run until clean

Loop: fix → `pnpm test:e2e` → triage remaining → fix. Exit when:
- Zero failing tests
- Zero axe `serious`/`critical` violations
- Zero uncaught console errors (warnings allowed with justification)

Bound: max 3 fix cycles. If issue count doesn't trend toward zero by cycle 3, stop and surface a summary to you for scope decision.

### Phase 5 — Commit + push + Railway smoke

1. Single commit: `test: add Playwright e2e harness + fix [N] regressions found`
2. Push to `origin/main` → Railway rebuilds
3. Run `pnpm test:e2e:smoke` against Railway once deploy is green
4. Final report: what was found, what was fixed, remaining known issues

| `.gitignore` | MODIFY — ignore `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, `e2e/.auth/` |
| `tsconfig.json` | MODIFY — include `e2e/**/*.ts` in compile scope |
| `.env.example` | MODIFY — document `BASE_URL` for smoke mode |

## Reusable existing code

- `lib/supabase/server.ts` — has `createServiceRoleClient()` pattern we'll mirror in `global-setup.ts`
- `.env.local` already has `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` for the Supabase admin auth user create

5. After fix cycles: `pnpm test:e2e` exits 0, zero serious/critical axe violations, zero console errors

## Out of scope

- Visual regression diffing (pixel-by-pixel baseline) — later pass, needs stable screenshots first
- Load testing, performance budgets — use Hawk separately if needed
- Supabase function runtime testing — functions tested in isolation, not via this sweep

export type RouteDef = {
  path: string
  label: string
  auth: 'public' | 'authed' | 'admin'
  // Pages that render different content based on auth state. Skip if bad target env.
  skipOnSmoke?: boolean
}

export const PUBLIC_ROUTES: RouteDef[] = [
  { path: '/login', label: 'login', auth: 'public' },
  { path: '/signup', label: 'signup', auth: 'public' },
  { path: '/forgot-password', label: 'forgot-password', auth: 'public' },
  { path: '/reset-password', label: 'reset-password', auth: 'public' },
  { path: '/privacy', label: 'privacy', auth: 'public' },
  { path: '/terms', label: 'terms', auth: 'public' },
  { path: '/pricing', label: 'pricing', auth: 'public' },
]

export const AUTHED_ROUTES: RouteDef[] = [
  { path: '/dashboard', label: 'dashboard', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/scan', label: 'scan', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/history', label: 'history', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/reports', label: 'reports', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/settings', label: 'settings', auth: 'authed' },

  { path: '/integrations', label: 'integrations', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/monitoring', label: 'monitoring', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/competitors', label: 'competitors', auth: 'authed' },
  { path: '/referrals', label: 'referrals', auth: 'authed' },
]

export const ADMIN_ROUTES: RouteDef[] = [
  { path: '/admin', label: 'admin-dashboard', auth: 'admin' },
  { path: '/admin/users', label: 'admin-users', auth: 'admin' },
  { path: '/admin/billing', label: 'admin-billing', auth: 'admin' },
  { path: '/admin/scans', label: 'admin-scans', auth: 'admin' },

# Sidebar Rebuild — Linear-exact Aesthetic (user + admin)

## Context

The current CROBOT sidebars (`AppSidebar` for user, the inline sidebar inside `AdminLayout` for admin) were grouped and tooltipped in a prior pass but still feel cheap. Specifically: the active state uses hardcoded `bg-white/10` with a left-border pill accent that reads as busy, the plan badge in the footer is unreadable (`text-2xs` + `border-white/10` + `text-sidebar-foreground/40`), the upgrade CTA feels disconnected from the scan-usage widget, the group labels are inconsistent (some groups unnamed, some "ANALYZE" / "MANAGE"), the mobile `SidebarTrigger` is 28×28 (below WCAG 44×44), and collapsed-mode icons don't feel deliberate.

Goal: rebuild both sidebars to match Linear exactly — no left-border pill, token-driven active background, 4 well-labeled groups, premium footer card, ⌘K hint visible, 44×44 mobile trigger, tight 240px expanded / 56px collapsed widths. Same visual system for both sidebars so the product feels unified.

## Current state (from exploration)

- `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` (231 lines) — user sidebar, 4 groups with 2 unlabeled
- `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` (319 lines) — admin sidebar inlined, 4 labeled groups
- `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — shadcn primitive, collapse width `--sidebar-width-icon: 3.5rem` (56px ✓), tooltip wiring already in place
- `app/globals.css` — sidebar tokens already defined (`--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-foreground-active`, `--sidebar-primary`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-border`, `--sidebar-ring`)
- `components/app/AppHeader.tsx` — uses `SidebarTrigger` on line 105
- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — already exists, ⌘K globally bound

## Approach

### Phase 1 — Token additions in `app/globals.css`

Add two new sidebar tokens so active state doesn't rely on hardcoded `bg-white/10`:

- `--sidebar-item-active-bg` = subtle elevated surface (oklch light + dark variants)
- `--sidebar-item-hover-bg` = even subtler surface

Existing tokens stay untouched — non-breaking.

### Phase 2 — `AppSidebar.tsx` rewrite (user sidebar)

1. **4 labeled groups**, every group has a 10px uppercase tracked label (Linear pattern). Current unlabeled groups get names:
   - **Workspace** — Dashboard, New Scan
   - **Analyze** — My Reports, Score History, Competitors
   - **Manage** — Integrations, Monitoring
   - **Account** — Refer & Earn, API, Settings

2. **Active state**: kill the `before:` left-border pill. Replace with `bg-[--sidebar-item-active-bg]` + `text-[--sidebar-foreground-active]` + icon color shift. Linear-tight.

3. **Hover state**: `hover:bg-[--sidebar-item-hover-bg]`. 150ms transition.

4. **Footer card** — rebuild as a single bordered card (not separator + floating button):
   - Top row: plan name (proper contrast, `text-xs` not `text-2xs`, `text-sidebar-foreground` not `/40`) + scan-count
   - Middle: progress bar
   - Bottom: Upgrade button (full-width when not on agency plan, hidden otherwise)
   - In collapsed mode: single icon-only pill with tooltip showing plan + usage

5. **⌘K hint row** below footer card — small muted `Search ⌘K` pill that triggers the command palette on click (reuses existing `CommandPalette`). Collapsed mode: hidden (⌘K still works globally).

6. **Remove hardcoded white opacities**: `bg-white/5`, `bg-white/10`, `border-white/10` → token-driven.

### Phase 3 — `AdminLayout.tsx` sidebar section rewrite

Same visual system as `AppSidebar`:
- Same active/hover state via the new tokens
- Same footer card pattern — but instead of upgrade CTA, the card shows "Admin mode" label + "Back to App" link as the primary action
- Kill the current dim `text-sidebar-foreground/50` "Back to App" — make it a proper button with token-driven contrast
- Keep admin groups as they are (Overview / Users & Data / Platform / System) — already good

### Phase 4 — `SidebarTrigger` mobile fix

File: `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` (`SidebarTrigger` component ~line 219).

Change: wrap the 28×28 icon button in an outer 44×44 hit area using the `after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` pattern already used elsewhere in the same file (~line 493). Visual remains 28×28 but tappable area is 44×44 on mobile.

### Phase 5 — Visual cleanup pass

- Ensure every icon in both sidebars is `h-4 w-4` (Linear uses 16px) — currently mixed between `h-4 w-4` and occasional different sizes
- Ensure nav item height is 36px expanded (Linear-tight), not the default shadcn 40px. Override via size prop or className.
- Group label: `text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-foreground/50` — tighten tracking, consistent for every group
- Separator between footer card and content: remove — card's border IS the separator

### Phase 6 — Verification

1. `pnpm typecheck` — clean
2. `pnpm build` — clean
3. Visual smoke:
   - Load `/dashboard` → sidebar renders with 4 labeled groups, active state on Dashboard
   - Collapse sidebar → icons-only, hover shows tooltips, footer shrinks to icon
   - Resize to mobile → hamburger is 44×44 tappable, drawer opens
   - Load `/admin` → admin sidebar matches user sidebar visually
   - Toggle dark mode → no `bg-white` flash, all tokens resolve
4. Grep check: `rg "bg-white/|border-white/" components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` → zero hits

## Critical files

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/globals.css` | ADD — 2 new sidebar tokens (active-bg, hover-bg) for light + dark |
| `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` | REWRITE — 4 labeled groups, no left-pill, footer card, ⌘K hint, token-driven |
| `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` | REWRITE sidebar block only (lines 140–220 range) — match AppSidebar system |
| `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` | EDIT — expand `SidebarTrigger` mobile hit area to 44×44 via `after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` |

## Reusable code (no duplication)

- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — reuse for ⌘K hint click action, already global-bound
- `components/ui/badge.tsx` — plan badge uses `Badge variant="neutral" size="sm"`, not a custom inline
- `components/shared/StatusBadge.tsx` — not applicable here, but pattern to follow for dot+label consistency
- Existing shadcn `SidebarGroup`, `SidebarGroupLabel`, `SidebarMenuButton`, `SidebarMenuItem` primitives in `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — reuse all

## Out of scope

- Top bar / `AppHeader` — stays as-is
- User dropdown menu — stays as-is (already polished)
- Admin top bar breadcrumb — stays as-is
- Actual nav items / routes — no additions, no removals, only reorganization under new group labels
- Dashboard / other page content — untouched

## Rollback

Every change is a file edit — `git restore <file>` reverts any single file. Full rollback: `git checkout HEAD -- components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx components/ui/sidebar.tsx app/globals.css`.

## Scope

## Approach

### Phase 0 — Prerequisites

1. Install test deps: `pnpm add -D @playwright/test @axe-core/playwright`
2. `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` (skip firefox/webkit — chromium covers 95% of UX issues and keeps run time sane)
3. Add scripts to `package.json`:
   - `test:e2e` → `playwright test`
   - `test:e2e:ui` → `playwright test --ui` (interactive mode for debugging)
   - `test:e2e:smoke` → `playwright test --grep @smoke` (Railway-only subset)

### Phase 1 — Test harness

Files to create:

- `playwright.config.ts` at repo root
  - `webServer`: `pnpm dev`, `url: http://localhost:3000`, reuse if already running
  - `projects`: `desktop-chrome` (1440×900), `tablet-chrome` (768×1024), `mobile-chrome` (375×812)
  - `use.trace: 'retain-on-failure'`, `use.screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`
  - `reporter`: `[['html'], ['list']]`
  - Two base URLs via env: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000` default, `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app` for smoke
- `e2e/global-setup.ts`
  - Creates a test user via Supabase admin API using `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` from `.env.local`: `playwright+{timestamp}@convertscan.dev` / auto-generated password
  - Writes storage state (authed session cookie) to `e2e/.auth/user.json`
  - Tests that need auth load storage state via `use({ storageState: 'e2e/.auth/user.json' })`
- `e2e/global-teardown.ts`
  - Deletes the test user via admin API after the run (cleanup)
- `e2e/helpers/`
  - `routes.ts` — exported list of routes (public + authed + admin)
  - `visual.ts` — `capturePage(page, name)` helper that snapshots light + dark and dumps to `test-results/screenshots/{theme}/{viewport}/{route}.png`
  - `a11y.ts` — `auditA11y(page)` wrapper around `@axe-core/playwright` that ignores known false positives
  - `console.ts` — `captureConsole(page)` collects errors/warnings, attaches to test via `testInfo.attach()`

Reuses existing infra:
- `supabase/functions/` and cloud project for the test user
- `.env.local` for `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` uses `next-themes` — tests flip theme by setting `localStorage.theme` or clicking the theme toggle

### Phase 2 — Test suites

Five spec files in `e2e/`:

1. **`visual-sweep.spec.ts`** — loops every route in `routes.ts`, `capturePage()` at each viewport × theme. No assertions other than "page loaded without error + no axe violations above serious." This is the volume-producer; ~120 screenshots/run.
2. **`auth-flow.spec.ts`** — landing → signup → dashboard. Checks redirect from `/` to `/login`, form validation, redirect to `/dashboard` on success, session persists on reload.
3. **`scan-flow.spec.ts`** — dashboard → `/scan` → paste URL → submit → verify streaming log panel renders → wait for report or mock-complete state.
4. **`nav-flow.spec.ts`** — Cmd+K palette opens, sidebar collapse/expand works, every sidebar item navigates, admin ↔ user mode switch.
5. **`smoke.spec.ts`** — tagged `@smoke`, runs against `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app`. Just: loads `/login`, loads `/api/health`, no 5xx.

### Phase 3 — Run + triage

1. `pnpm test:e2e` locally → generates `test-results/` with screenshots, `playwright-report/` HTML report
2. I read the report summary (not raw screenshots — too large for context) and categorize failures:
   - **BLOCKING**: 500 errors, unrecoverable crashes, CSP violations
   - **VISUAL P1**: dark-mode breakage, broken responsive, unreadable contrast
   - **VISUAL P2**: alignment nits, spacing inconsistencies, minor polish
   - **A11Y**: axe violations by severity
   - **CONSOLE**: browser console errors / unhandled promise rejections
3. Route findings to agents by category:
   - BLOCKING → 🐛 Vex (root-cause fix)
   - VISUAL P1/P2 → 🎨 Vega (spec change if needed) → ⚡ Koda (implement)
   - A11Y → Koda with Sage gating
   - CONSOLE → Vex triage → Koda fix
4. Agents work in parallel where files don't overlap.

### Phase 4 — Re-run until clean

Loop: fix → `pnpm test:e2e` → triage remaining → fix. Exit when:
- Zero failing tests
- Zero axe `serious`/`critical` violations
- Zero uncaught console errors (warnings allowed with justification)

Bound: max 3 fix cycles. If issue count doesn't trend toward zero by cycle 3, stop and surface a summary to you for scope decision.

### Phase 5 — Commit + push + Railway smoke

1. Single commit: `test: add Playwright e2e harness + fix [N] regressions found`
2. Push to `origin/main` → Railway rebuilds
3. Run `pnpm test:e2e:smoke` against Railway once deploy is green
4. Final report: what was found, what was fixed, remaining known issues

## Critical files

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `playwright.config.ts` | NEW — Playwright config, viewports, webServer |
| `e2e/global-setup.ts` | NEW — creates Supabase test user, stores session |
| `e2e/global-teardown.ts` | NEW — cleanup test user |
| `e2e/helpers/{routes,visual,a11y,console}.ts` | NEW — reusable test helpers |
| `e2e/{visual-sweep,auth-flow,scan-flow,nav-flow,smoke}.spec.ts` | NEW — 5 test suites |
| `package.json` | MODIFY — add test:e2e scripts + deps |
| `.gitignore` | MODIFY — ignore `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, `e2e/.auth/` |
| `tsconfig.json` | MODIFY — include `e2e/**/*.ts` in compile scope |
| `.env.example` | MODIFY — document `BASE_URL` for smoke mode |

## Reusable existing code

- `lib/supabase/server.ts` — has `createServiceRoleClient()` pattern we'll mirror in `global-setup.ts`
- `.env.local` already has `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` for the Supabase admin auth user create
- `components/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx` — `next-themes` wrapper, tests flip theme by `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')` or `localStorage.setItem('theme','dark')`
- `nixpacks.toml` stays unchanged — Playwright never runs on Railway, only locally

## Verification

1. `pnpm exec playwright --version` prints a version
2. `pnpm test:e2e` runs end-to-end, produces `playwright-report/index.html`
3. `pnpm exec playwright show-report` opens the report in browser — every route has a screenshot row
4. `test-results/screenshots/{light,dark}/{desktop,tablet,mobile}/` directories populated with ~120 PNGs
5. After fix cycles: `pnpm test:e2e` exits 0, zero serious/critical axe violations, zero console errors
6. Smoke: `BASE_URL=https://crobot.up.railway.app pnpm test:e2e:smoke` exits 0 after Railway deploy

## Out of scope

- Cross-browser testing (Firefox/WebKit) — Chromium only this pass
- Visual regression diffing (pixel-by-pixel baseline) — later pass, needs stable screenshots first
- Load testing, performance budgets — use Hawk separately if needed
- Supabase function runtime testing — functions tested in isolation, not via this sweep
- Real payment flows (Dodo) — mocked or skipped

## Guardrails

- Test user is created fresh each run, deleted on teardown. No pollution in Supabase.
- Storage state file `e2e/.auth/user.json` is gitignored — never committed.
- Smoke tests run read-only on Railway — no data writes, no new users, no scans.
- If Railway smoke discovers a bug that local doesn't reproduce, Vex investigates (likely env-var drift).
- `--grep @smoke` for Railway, default full suite for local — prevents accidental prod writes.

# Sidebar Rebuild — Linear-exact Aesthetic (user + admin)

## Context

The current CROBOT sidebars (`AppSidebar` for user, the inline sidebar inside `AdminLayout` for admin) were grouped and tooltipped in a prior pass but still feel cheap. Specifically: the active state uses hardcoded `bg-white/10` with a left-border pill accent that reads as busy, the plan badge in the footer is unreadable (`text-2xs` + `border-white/10` + `text-sidebar-foreground/40`), the upgrade CTA feels disconnected from the scan-usage widget, the group labels are inconsistent (some groups unnamed, some "ANALYZE" / "MANAGE"), the mobile `SidebarTrigger` is 28×28 (below WCAG 44×44), and collapsed-mode icons don't feel deliberate.

Goal: rebuild both sidebars to match Linear exactly — no left-border pill, token-driven active background, 4 well-labeled groups, premium footer card, ⌘K hint visible, 44×44 mobile trigger, tight 240px expanded / 56px collapsed widths. Same visual system for both sidebars so the product feels unified.

## Current state (from exploration)

- `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` (231 lines) — user sidebar, 4 groups with 2 unlabeled
- `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` (319 lines) — admin sidebar inlined, 4 labeled groups
- `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — shadcn primitive, collapse width `--sidebar-width-icon: 3.5rem` (56px ✓), tooltip wiring already in place
- `app/globals.css` — sidebar tokens already defined (`--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-foreground-active`, `--sidebar-primary`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-border`, `--sidebar-ring`)
- `components/app/AppHeader.tsx` — uses `SidebarTrigger` on line 105
- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — already exists, ⌘K globally bound

## Approach

### Phase 1 — Token additions in `app/globals.css`

Add two new sidebar tokens so active state doesn't rely on hardcoded `bg-white/10`:

- `--sidebar-item-active-bg` = subtle elevated surface (oklch light + dark variants)
- `--sidebar-item-hover-bg` = even subtler surface

Existing tokens stay untouched — non-breaking.

### Phase 2 — `AppSidebar.tsx` rewrite (user sidebar)

1. **4 labeled groups**, every group has a 10px uppercase tracked label (Linear pattern). Current unlabeled groups get names:
   - **Workspace** — Dashboard, New Scan
   - **Analyze** — My Reports, Score History, Competitors
   - **Manage** — Integrations, Monitoring
   - **Account** — Refer & Earn, API, Settings

2. **Active state**: kill the `before:` left-border pill. Replace with `bg-[--sidebar-item-active-bg]` + `text-[--sidebar-foreground-active]` + icon color shift. Linear-tight.

3. **Hover state**: `hover:bg-[--sidebar-item-hover-bg]`. 150ms transition.

4. **Footer card** — rebuild as a single bordered card (not separator + floating button):
   - Top row: plan name (proper contrast, `text-xs` not `text-2xs`, `text-sidebar-foreground` not `/40`) + scan-count
   - Middle: progress bar
   - Bottom: Upgrade button (full-width when not on agency plan, hidden otherwise)
   - In collapsed mode: single icon-only pill with tooltip showing plan + usage

5. **⌘K hint row** below footer card — small muted `Search ⌘K` pill that triggers the command palette on click (reuses existing `CommandPalette`). Collapsed mode: hidden (⌘K still works globally).

6. **Remove hardcoded white opacities**: `bg-white/5`, `bg-white/10`, `border-white/10` → token-driven.

### Phase 3 — `AdminLayout.tsx` sidebar section rewrite

Same visual system as `AppSidebar`:
- Same active/hover state via the new tokens
- Same footer card pattern — but instead of upgrade CTA, the card shows "Admin mode" label + "Back to App" link as the primary action
- Kill the current dim `text-sidebar-foreground/50` "Back to App" — make it a proper button with token-driven contrast
- Keep admin groups as they are (Overview / Users & Data / Platform / System) — already good

### Phase 4 — `SidebarTrigger` mobile fix

File: `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` (`SidebarTrigger` component ~line 219).

Change: wrap the 28×28 icon button in an outer 44×44 hit area using the `after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` pattern already used elsewhere in the same file (~line 493). Visual remains 28×28 but tappable area is 44×44 on mobile.

### Phase 5 — Visual cleanup pass

- Ensure every icon in both sidebars is `h-4 w-4` (Linear uses 16px) — currently mixed between `h-4 w-4` and occasional different sizes
- Ensure nav item height is 36px expanded (Linear-tight), not the default shadcn 40px. Override via size prop or className.
- Group label: `text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-foreground/50` — tighten tracking, consistent for every group
- Separator between footer card and content: remove — card's border IS the separator

### Phase 6 — Verification

1. `pnpm typecheck` — clean
2. `pnpm build` — clean
3. Visual smoke:
   - Load `/dashboard` → sidebar renders with 4 labeled groups, active state on Dashboard
   - Collapse sidebar → icons-only, hover shows tooltips, footer shrinks to icon
   - Resize to mobile → hamburger is 44×44 tappable, drawer opens
   - Load `/admin` → admin sidebar matches user sidebar visually
   - Toggle dark mode → no `bg-white` flash, all tokens resolve
4. Grep check: `rg "bg-white/|border-white/" components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` → zero hits

## Critical files

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `app/globals.css` | ADD — 2 new sidebar tokens (active-bg, hover-bg) for light + dark |
| `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` | REWRITE — 4 labeled groups, no left-pill, footer card, ⌘K hint, token-driven |
| `components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx` | REWRITE sidebar block only (lines 140–220 range) — match AppSidebar system |
| `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` | EDIT — expand `SidebarTrigger` mobile hit area to 44×44 via `after:-inset-2 after:md:hidden` |

## Reusable code (no duplication)

- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — reuse for ⌘K hint click action, already global-bound
- `components/ui/badge.tsx` — plan badge uses `Badge variant="neutral" size="sm"`, not a custom inline
- `components/shared/StatusBadge.tsx` — not applicable here, but pattern to follow for dot+label consistency
- Existing shadcn `SidebarGroup`, `SidebarGroupLabel`, `SidebarMenuButton`, `SidebarMenuItem` primitives in `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — reuse all

## Out of scope

- Top bar / `AppHeader` — stays as-is
- User dropdown menu — stays as-is (already polished)
- Admin top bar breadcrumb — stays as-is
- Actual nav items / routes — no additions, no removals, only reorganization under new group labels
- Dashboard / other page content — untouched

## Rollback

Every change is a file edit — `git restore <file>` reverts any single file. Full rollback: `git checkout HEAD -- components/app/sidebar components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx components/ui/sidebar.tsx app/globals.css`.

Look at line 176: `className="group peer hidden text-sidebar-foreground md:block"`

The **peer wrapper is `display: block`**, not `display: flex`. It's a flex child of `SidebarProvider`'s inner div. But `display: block` inside a flex container works fine — it becomes a flex item.

# Diagnose + Fix Sidebar Overlap (continuation)

## Context

User reports dashboard content ("Welcome back Yash 👋") rendering clipped by the sidebar. Two fixes shipped already:
1. `e066678` — AppShell/AdminLayout switched from custom flex wrapper to shadcn `SidebarInset`
2. `baa231f` — Removed nested `<main>` tags

User screenshot after both fixes still shows clipping. Reason unclear — my theories so far (nested main, custom flex) were directionally right but apparently not the actual cause.

Rather than keep shotgun-fixing, this plan is: **reproduce the bug deterministically first, then fix with certainty.** The sidebar design itself (groups, footer, ⌘K) looks correct in the screenshot — the only remaining issue is layout spacing.

## Possible causes (ranked by likelihood)

1. **Old Railway deploy still serving** — Railway rebuild delay + Chrome cache. Hard-refresh hasn't been tried explicitly. The screenshot user pasted may pre-date deploy completion.
2. **`SidebarProvider` flex layout has extra flex children** — `SkipToContent` + `CommandPalette` sit before `Sidebar` in `AppShell`. Even if they render nothing visually, they occupy flex slot indexes. If either has non-zero width, it pushes sidebar right and breaks the layout assumption.
3. **`AppHeader` height issue** — The header inside `SidebarInset` may have fixed positioning or overflow that causes the content below to start at wrong Y, which interacts with sidebar Y positioning.
4. **Tailwind `has-[[data-variant=inset]]` selector not matching** — `SidebarProvider`'s root has `has-[[data-variant=inset]]:bg-sidebar`. We use `variant="sidebar"` (default) not `inset`, so this shouldn't fire, but worth verifying.
5. **Page-level `PageTransition` wrapper** — Dashboard uses `<PageTransition>` which may have `position: absolute` or `overflow: hidden` that creates a stacking context hiding content behind the sidebar's fixed layer.
6. **CSP blocking a style import** — Less likely, but possible.

## Approach

### Phase A — Deterministic reproduction (read-only)

1. Confirm which commit Railway is serving (check `x-railway-deployment-id` header if exposed, or compare rendered HTML against known-current HTML)
2. Spin up local dev server, programmatically sign in (or bypass auth via middleware skip), navigate to `/dashboard`
3. Render page with Playwright headless, capture full-page screenshot at 1440×900 desktop viewport
4. Extract the rendered DOM tree — confirm: `SidebarProvider > (SkipToContent, CommandPalette, Sidebar, SidebarInset)` with computed widths
5. Inspect computed CSS of:
   - `SidebarProvider` outer div (flex?)
   - The peer wrapper `<div class="group peer ...">` (block? width?)
   - The inner gap-reserver div (relative, width: 16rem?)
   - `SidebarInset` (flex-1? what's its computed width + left position?)
6. Determine exact pixel math: sidebar right edge at X, content left edge at Y. If Y < X, we have the bug.

If the dev reproduction does NOT show overlap → bug is Railway-cache-only and resolves with a proper hard-reload. We tell user to clear cache.

If dev reproduction DOES show overlap → we have a bug to fix. Continue to Phase B.

### Phase B — Targeted fix (only if Phase A reproduces)

Based on computed-CSS findings:

- **If peer wrapper width is 0** → `SkipToContent` or `CommandPalette` is taking flex space. Fix: move them outside `SidebarProvider` (render them at top of `AuthProvider`).
- **If peer wrapper width is 256px but `SidebarInset` starts at 0** → flex layout not applying. Fix: wrap `AppSidebar` + `SidebarInset` in an explicit `<div className="flex min-h-svh w-full">` within SidebarProvider, or verify `SidebarProvider`'s root actually becomes flex in the rendered HTML.
- **If `SidebarInset` starts correctly at 256px but CONTENT starts at <256px** → `PageTransition` or page component has absolute positioning breaking it. Fix: remove breakout.
- **If mobile drawer is leaking into desktop** → CSS media query breaking. Fix: explicit `md:` breakpoint verification.

### Phase C — Verification

1. Replay the same Playwright-rendered screenshot, confirm content starts after sidebar ends
2. Manual open in real Chrome at multiple widths (375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440) to confirm responsive works
3. Toggle sidebar collapse — content should smoothly fill freed space
4. Commit single fix, push to Railway
5. Wait for Railway deploy, hard-reload, user verifies

## Critical files (will know after Phase A)

Probable candidates in order:
- `components/app/AppShell.tsx` — re-examine SidebarProvider child ordering
- `components/shared/CommandPalette.tsx` — check if it renders an inline trigger div
- `components/shared/SkipToContent.tsx` — check visibility
- `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` — rarely, but possible if `SidebarInset` has a wrong `flex-1`
- `components/shared/PageTransition.tsx` — check for absolute positioning
- `app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx` — check if any outer wrapper breaks out of SidebarInset

## Verification

- Playwright screenshot at 1440×900 from `/dashboard` shows content NOT clipped by sidebar
- DOM inspection confirms: sidebar ends at X, content starts at X + padding
- Works at 768 (tablet) and 1440 (desktop) widths
- Collapse toggle works — content re-flows when sidebar shrinks to 48px icon mode
- Hard-reload on Railway shows same result as local

## Rollback

Every change is git-tracked. If any fix breaks something worse, `git revert <commit>` or `git restore <file>`.

## Out of scope

- No more redesign of the sidebar visuals — they're already correct
- No changes to AuthContext, Supabase, middleware
- No changes to routes or data fetching

## Discipline

**Do not ship another fix without first reproducing the bug.** Previous two fixes were educated guesses that the user had to verify. This time: reproduce → diagnose → single surgical fix → verify → ship.
